report.scoreReason: The JEE prep app market has multiple apps with over 1,000,000 downloads alongside entries by giants like Google Gemini, though incumbent apps remain largely static PYQ banks.

demand.note: Search interest demonstrates high seasonality, rising to a peak of 100 during March 8–14, 2026 around exam schedules, accompanied by breakout queries for 60-day preparation.

competitors.name: MARKS: IIT JEE & NEET Prep App
competitors.weakness: Lacks AI-driven interactive tutoring and real-time conversational doubt resolution.
competitors.evidence: Description lists features strictly around chapter-wise PYQs, NTA Abhyas questions, practice challenges, and bookmarks without any AI tutoring capability.

competitors.name: Jeehub: IIT JEE Study App
competitors.weakness: Does not provide automated AI tutoring or personalized question generation.
competitors.evidence: Description focuses entirely on PYQs, study materials, and Live Focus Rooms to maintain flow state.

competitors.name: IIT JEE Mains & Advanced Prep
competitors.weakness: Relies on standard self-paced study notes and mock tests rather than interactive AI assistance.
competitors.evidence: Description promotes self-paced learning without coaching classes, emphasizing mock tests and books rather than AI tutoring.

competitors.name: IIT JEE Prep App by Achieve
competitors.weakness: Limited to static question banks without adaptive AI tutoring or guidance.
competitors.evidence: App description only details 36K+ practice MCQs, chapter-wise mock tests, and past papers.

competitors.name: JEE Mains & JEE Advance 2027
competitors.weakness: Offers only static reading material and mock tests with no AI tutoring functionality.
competitors.evidence: Description mentions bite-sized study material, sample papers, and chapterwise MCQs with All India Rank.

gaps: Dedicated conversational AI tutoring to replace static PDF and PYQ banks found in apps like MARKS and ExamGOAL
Targeted accelerated prep workflows addressing the breakout query 'jee main 2026 preparation 60 days'
Curriculum tailored to developing core problem-solving concepts, supported by the +4,400% surge in 'jee preparation tips engineering skills'
report.hiring: Companies including PlanetSpark, Infinity Learn, and Trivium Education are actively and urgently hiring online tutors for math and science subjects.
newsSignals: Google has integrated Gemini into JEE prep to offer AI-driven practice and feedback at scale.
AI tutor startup SigIQ.ai raised $9.5M to scale globally after competing against entrance exam students.
Major coaching institutes like Allen and PhysicsWallah are pivoting into AI test prep, with PhysicsWallah partnering with Microsoft.
report.verdictReason: Despite a competitive score of 74 driven by Google Gemini and funded players, existing store apps completely lack interactive AI tutoring and remain confined to static PYQ banks. This gap—paired with breakout demand for specialized formats like 'jee main 2026 preparation 60 days'—provides a clear opening for an AI-native JEE tutor.
nextSteps: Build a conversational prototype focused specifically on solving JEE Mains PYQs with step-by-step conceptual hints.
Design an accelerated 60-day revision module to directly capture the breakout demand shown in Google Trends.
Interview students currently using static apps like MARKS and Jeehub to validate their willingness to switch to an AI tutor.
